_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. Seven remain and NONE is merely unwired — each is blocked on a decision or a missing system: charm_effectiveness_pct and social_roll_pct need events to declare what kind of check a roll is; crafting_quality_pct needs crafted items to have a quality at all; crafting_yield_pct is owned by Alchemy while crafting reads Smithing; loot_quality_pct needs loot rarity to be a thing; max_companions would replace the hardcoded max_party_size of 8 with a Leadership cap of 5, a party-size design change; trap_detection_pct waits on the traps design. See TODO for each.

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
